posts.title: Note 2026-11-12T17:07:59.000-08:00
posts.description: Trying a new (to me) browser cookie manager for chrome-based browsers: CookieMaid — auto-delete cookies when tabs close. Free, open-source MV3 replacement for Cookie AutoDelete: whitelist, greylist, scheduled sweep, no telemetry. · GitHub https://github.com/moeatsy/cookiemaid Also has options to allow clean up of LocalStorage, IndexedDB, Service Workers and Cache & Storage.
